summary:
Held 0 of today's 10 biggest UK/EU movers.

• 6 upside misses — CCC.L +11%, BAB.L +6%, RR.L +6%, ENR.DE +4%, IFX.DE +4%. These cleared the universe screen but no strategy picked them up; the morning brief either filtered them on a catalyst/RSI/earnings rule or had nothing positive to trigger an entry.

• 4 downside moves (EXPN.L -6%, EL.PA -3%, AUTO.L -2%, RAND.AS -2%) are unreachable on a long-only basket — no mechanism to express a short or pair-trade.

• Most instructive miss: CCC.L (+10.89%) — Computacenter (if CCC.L is Computacenter) lifted FY26 PBT guidance to ≥£425m on 26 Oct, with the AI/hyperscale order backlog at £12.6bn. Today's +10.9% looks like follow-through. I found no distinct Oct 27 news, and the 50.898 close doesn't match the ~58 I'd expect. Why we passed: Outside any active strategy's universe: a UK mid-cap IT reseller (FTSE 250) that no strategy's universe lists. The catalyst was announced the day before, so the gap-up came a session earlier and any news-reactive or earnings-gate logic had already moved on.
